prompts.name: fan1
prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: one botanical albedo cutout for a saw palmetto game texture atlas. Generate ONE fresh young saw palmetto leaf blade, WITHOUT ANY STALK, isolated on actual transparent alpha. Straight-on orthographic view, as a specimen laid flat and photographed directly overhead. Match the stiff fine-pointed fan character seen in the supplied project concepts. Fresh yellow-green, subtle natural wax, fine parallel veins and radial pleats, minute uneven botanical imperfections; natural photograph detail, not illustration. A broad 180 to 195 degree fan with about 32 long narrow pointed segments: middle segments longest, lateral segments slightly shorter, 3 tips fork into two fine points. Segments join in a small basal web and radiate upward and outward from the tiny hastula at the very bottom centre; do not draw any petiole below it. Broad fan silhouette roughly 1.8 times as wide as tall, no lower semicircle, no complete circle. Whole blade fully visible with generous transparent margin, fills most of image width. Flat unlit surface colour, diffuse cross-polarized scan, NO directional shading, NO cast shadows, NO specular highlights. Crisp opaque leaf interiors and clean alpha edges, no haze. No soil, no pot, no text, no borders, no extra leaves.
